initialExam.title: SBI PO 2026
initialExam.description: SBI Probationary Officer exam for India's largest bank. Highly competitive with excellent career prospects.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (30Q), Quant (35Q), Reasoning (35Q). Mains: Reasoning/Computer (45Q), Data Analysis (35Q), GK/Economy (40Q), English (35Q) + Descriptive.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 170Q + Descriptive, 200+30 marks. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Probationary Officer in State Bank of India
initialExam.careerGrowth: PO → Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM → CGM → DMD → MD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit sbi.co.in/web/careers 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Basic pay (12th Bipartite Settlement) + DA + HRA

initialExam.perks: Leased accommodation, Medical, LFC, Loans at reduced rates, Performance bonus
